job_authority: Original immutable BOM/material versions, declared exact expansion and resource/source identity; independent bounded job review plus a separate exact-step review using current kernel permissions
native_stock_owner: Existing WarehouseFixtureSource warehouse_stock with WarehouseInventoryFixtureSource movement/command receipts
native_production_state: warehouse_inventory_production records reservation/consumption and WIP, analogous to the original transfer reservation state; it does not own a second available-stock ledger

transitions.reserve: Reserve the complete expanded leaf quantities once; available decreases, reserved increases, on_hand unchanged
transitions.consume: Only fully reserved component requirements can be consumed; reserved and on_hand decrease together, WIP gains the frozen component cost
transitions.release: Only unconsumed reservations return to available; no finished output
transitions.complete: Source-observed actual partial good/scrap quantities, after all required consumption is reconciled, bounded by planned good and gross output; only good units add finished stock
transitions.correct_output: A source-observed linked negative good/positive scrap reclassification is bounded by the original output and remaining available finished stock; no implicit component rollback

conservation: component cost = WIP cost + good output cost + scrap cost
output is forbidden before all components are consumed
current_guard: Current authenticated dispatcher, actual proposer and independent approver permissions/revisions, exact job and command digests, current source/canonical positions, original BOM plan, approval expiry and one-use status, both stock/warehouse execution stamps and recovery fences are rechecked in the original source transaction
idempotency: Job-stage identity or original actual output event ID selects one operation regardless of caller key; native persistent binding plus original command journal prevents another output receipt
unknown: Crash after commit retains original output operation and blocks later job transitions until source lookup and movement import reconcile it
privacy_restore: Sanitize all business-body schemas; revoke every production/step review and effect authority even without customer tombstones; preserve original unknown command, source and BOM/cost lineage
targeted_fault: Actual isolated productionCompletion omits its consumed-component guard and admits output from reserved-only native state; an independent zero-output assertion detects it
remaining_limits: No physical production qualification or automatic worker
Consumption is complete per approved job, while output/scrap can be partial
Output corrections support explicit good-to-scrap reclassification only
No component unconsumption, replacement job, stock repair or unknown-operation retry is inferred
Separate source/kernel databases do not constitute a distributed production transaction
M07-G99 and M08-G99 formal prerequisites remain blocked
